# telnyx_dynamic_emergency_addresses (Data Source)

Lists dynamic emergency addresses, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_dynamic_emergency_address`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_country_code` (String) Filter by country code.
- `filter_status` (String) Filter by status. One of `activated`, `pending`, `rejected`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `dynamic_emergency_addresses` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dynamic_emergency_addresses))

<a id="nestedatt--dynamic_emergency_addresses"></a>

Read-Only:

- `country_code` (String)
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date of when the resource was created
